attribution: Bergmann, Fauser, Sattlegger and Steger, CVPR 2019; MVTec Software GmbH
data_origin: Existing local bottle.tar.xz; category files reused read-only

policy.evaluation: entire unchanged official test set; labels kept separately
policy.overlap: reject matching SHA-256 image content across splits
policy.ranking: sha256(seed:relative_posix_path), ascending; floor with at least one image per split
policy.threshold_tuning: normal validation holdout only; never official test images or labels
policy.training: official train/good excluding normal validation holdout

note: Every archive file matches the local extraction. This does not certify completeness against an independent official inventory.
